Portronics Muffs M5 Headphone (Black) – Wireless ANC, 50 Hours Playtime

The Portronics Muffs M5 Headphone is designed for listeners who want powerful sound, long battery life, and modern wireless convenience. Equipped with Bluetooth 5.3, advanced Active Noise Cancellation, and an impressive 50 hours playback time, this over-ear headphone delivers immersive audio for music, movies, calls, gaming, and travel. The sleek black finish adds a premium touch, while the lightweight foldable design ensures all-day comfort.

Whether you are working from home, commuting, attending online meetings, or relaxing with your favorite playlist, the Portronics Muffs M5 Headphone provides stable connectivity, deep bass, and crystal-clear vocals. The built-in microphone ensures smooth calling, and the Type C fast charging port keeps you powered up quickly.

Key Highlights

  • Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) for distraction-free listening
  • Latest Bluetooth 5.3 for faster pairing and stable wireless connection
  • Massive 50 hours playback on a single charge
  • Premium over-ear design with soft ear cushions
  • In-built mic for hands-free calls and online meetings
  • Type C charging for quick and convenient power-up
  • Stylish black color suitable for work, travel, and daily use

Immersive Audio with ANC

Enjoy your music without background disturbances. The Portronics Muffs M5 Headphone features powerful ANC technology that reduces environmental noise, making it ideal for flights, offices, and busy streets. Experience deeper bass, clear mids, and detailed highs with a truly cinematic feel.

Extended 50 Hours Battery Life

Long listening sessions are easy with up to 50 hours of playback time. From binge watching to extended work calls, the Portronics Muffs M5 Headphone keeps going without frequent charging. When you finally need power, the Type C port offers fast and reliable charging.

Seamless Bluetooth 5.3 Connectivity

With advanced Bluetooth 5.3, you get low latency, improved range, and efficient battery performance. Pair the quickly with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and smart TVs for uninterrupted entertainment.

Comfortable for All-Day Wear

Built with soft earcups and an adjustable headband, this is perfect for long usage. The ergonomic structure helps reduce pressure on ears, making the suitable for travel, office work, gaming, and study sessions.

Clear Calls with Built-in Microphone

Take calls effortlessly with the integrated mic. Your voice remains clear during meetings, classes, and chats, ensuring professional communication wherever you are.

Why Choose ?

If you need a wireless ANC with long battery life, premium comfort, and modern features, this model is an excellent choice. The combination of Bluetooth 5.3, 50-hour playtime, and Type C charging makes the a reliable everyday audio companion.

Specifications

  • Model: Muffs M5
  • Color: Black
  • Bluetooth Version: 5.3
  • ANC Enabled: Yes
  • Playback Time: Up to 50 Hours
  • Charging Port: Type C
  • Microphone: Yes
